title: Tooling: 3.15× faster production Clifford zero_state via gate tables with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, production multicold `clifford_exact.py` still built the exact zero state by expanding the Clifford circuit. The opt-in adapter `research/clifford-state-performance/` (lineage of [#662](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/662)) already proved gate-table permutation/phase evaluation with identical cold617 helper-interface receipts. This PR wires that equivalent `zero_state` into the **production** multicold evaluator used by `scripts/verify_cold617_interface.py`.

Path: `research/complex-multicold/vendor/pr558/vendor/pr552/complex-global/vendor531/vendor/clifford/clifford_exact.py`.

No certificate κ pins change. Same-tip provenance hygiene:
- `research/clifford-state-performance/` vendors pairwise-era bytes as `baseline.py` and demotes the live pairwise pin.
- `research/clifford-reciprocal-basis-obstruction/` demotes `clifford_exact` to **provenance** and drops it from live `VERIFY.json` inputs.
- `research/cold-wrapper-amplitude-audit/` moves the pairwise `clifford_exact` digest to `provenance_sha256` (that audit does not import the module).

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 with pinned CPU, five alternating fresh-process pairs gave median helper-interface wall time **1.202 → 0.382 s (3.15×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Helper-interface receipts match the baseline evaluator (`states=100`, `instances=2`).

Package: `research/clifford-state-production/`.
Tip: `68a7161a610f175dc8e7b22f95acd033191450d9`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/clifford-state-production/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/clifford-state-production/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clifford-state-production
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clifford-reciprocal-basis-obstruction
python3.12 -B research/cold-wrapper-amplitude-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -B -m unittest tests.test_clifford_state_production
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_CLIFFORD_STATE_PRODUCTION states=100 instances=2 corruption=subprocess_failure certs=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/clifford-state-production outcome=completed
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/clifford-reciprocal-basis-obstruction outcome=completed
PASS_COLD_WRAPPER_AMPLITUDE_AUDIT …
```

Helper-interface receipt/benchmark runs briefly **swap the live** production `clifford_exact.py` under `try`/`finally` restore, because `scripts/verify_cold617_interface.py` forces `MULTICOLD_SOURCE` onto the repository multicold tree (temporary overlays are ignored). The working tree is restored after every run. Permutation-foil rejects via subprocess failure. Package gates under `-O` still launch assertion-enabled children. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated evaluator change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different delivery): `research/clifford-state-performance/` / [#662](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/662) (opt-in gate tables; this is the production wiring), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2257) / [#2263](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2263) / [#2276](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2276) / [#2320](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2320) (same production-promotion + provenance pattern). No competing open PR on this production `clifford_exact.py` at refresh.

Credit Charles Bethin and the multicold Clifford lineage. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
